items.summaryZh: 利亚姆·劳森在奥斯汀的Garage 各节练习与排位 with 劳森 and Friends音乐会上，得到了丹尼尔·里卡多的现场支持。

media.altZh: 粉丝激动：里卡多在奥斯汀现场支持利亚姆·劳森 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Fans lose it as Daniel Ricciardo spotted supporting Liam Lawson at Austin live performance
detailZh: 粉丝们在奥斯汀现场表演中看到丹尼尔·里卡多支持利亚姆·劳森时情绪失控
小红牛车手利亚姆·劳森在美国大奖赛前夕在奥斯汀登台进行罕见的现场音乐表演
丹尼尔·里卡多，Visa Cash App 小红牛 F1车队
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
利亚姆·劳森在周四晚上在奥斯汀的舞台上看到了一些熟悉的面孔。
这位新西兰人在Esses Bazaar ATX的Garage 各节练习与排位 with 劳森 and Friends上担任主角，这是在美国大奖赛周末之前在东第六街的Inn Cahoots举行的。
劳森在2024年取代了丹尼尔·里卡多在小红牛的位置，里卡多在那里观看，还有他现在的队友阿维德·林德布拉德和前队友伊萨克·哈吉尔也在场。
劳森与他的兄弟马库斯以及两个童年好友托马斯和哈里森一起表演，这是他自11岁以来第一次公开表演。
“我有很多感受。我的意思是，我对……能和我的兄弟还有几个从小一起玩的朋友一起做这件事感到很兴奋，”这位24岁的年轻人告诉在奥斯汀表演前的媒体。
“说实话，我们大概有10年没做过这样的事情了。显然，我们从未真正表演过，但我们很小的时候就一起长大了。所以这是一个很酷的机会。但当然，我紧张得要命。”
当被问及现场表演的压力是否比大奖赛更大时，劳森补充说：“哦我的天，比这多10倍的压力。我宁愿坐进一辆一级方程式赛车去Q3，也不愿做这件事。”
小红牛在社交媒体上分享了劳森和里卡多在活动中的照片，以及表演的几个视频。一位粉丝评论道：“小红牛给了人们他们想要的东西，”另一位补充说：“澳大利亚和新西兰喜欢看到这一切。”
“哦我的天哪，我对这件事（我100%在尖叫）完全冷静和沉着，”另一位粉丝发布了一条帖子。
美国大奖赛将于10月25日在美洲赛道举行。
detailEn: Fans lose it as Daniel Ricciardo spotted supporting Liam Lawson at Austin live performance
Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson took to the stage for a rare live music performance in Austin ahead of the United States Grand Prix
Daniel Ricciardo, Visa Cash App RB F1 Team
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Liam Lawson had some familiar faces in the crowd as he took to the stage in Austin on Thursday night.
The New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends at part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.
Daniel Ricciardo, who Lawson replaced at Racing Bulls in 2024, was there to watch along with current team-mate Arvid Lindblad and former team-mate Isack Hadjar.
Lawson performed alongside his brother Marcus and two childhood friends, Thomas and Harrison, in what was his first public performance since he was 11.

"I am feeling a lot of things. I mean, I'm excited for... It's a cool opportunity to do this with my brother and a couple of friends that I've grown up playing with," the 24-year-old told the media in Austin ahead of the performance.

"To be honest, we haven't done this for like 10 years. And obviously, we never really performed, but we grew up playing together when we were very young. So it's a cool opportunity. But no, I'm sh***ing myself, for sure."

When asked if there was more pressure for the live performance than for a grand prix, Lawson added: "Oh my God, like 10 times more pressure for this. I would happily get in a Formula 1 car and go into Q3 over doing this."

Racing Bulls shared a photo of Lawson and Ricciardo at the event, along with several videos from the performance. "Racing Bulls giving the people what they want," one fan commented, while another added: "Australasia loves to see it."
"OH MY GOD, I'M TOTALLY CALM AND COLLECTED ABOUT THIS (I’m 110% screaming)," another fan posted.
The United States Grand Prix will take place on 25 October at the Circuit of the Americas.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯向麦凯轮发出严厉警告：“这是我开过最难的车”
items.summaryZh: 尽管诺里斯本赛季早些时候取得了杆位和指挥性的胜利，但他承认他的麦凯轮在赛道上完全是个噩梦。

media.altZh: 诺里斯向麦凯轮发出严厉警告：“这是我开过最难的车” · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Norris issues brutal warning to McLaren: “One of the hardest cars I’ve ever had to drive”
detailZh: 诺里斯向麦凯轮发出严厉警告：“这是我开过最难的车”
尽管诺里斯本赛季早些时候取得了杆位和指挥性的胜利，但他承认他的麦凯轮在赛道上完全是个噩梦。
对于麦凯轮的粉丝来说，这是来自沃金克的帕帕亚新闻，包括关于车手、赛车、团队策略和每个周末的赛事的最新消息。
当一位一级方程式车手连续取得杆位和指挥性的胜利时，人们自然会认为他们的赛车调校得完美，驾驶起来就像在轨道上一样。但兰多·诺里斯完全打破了这一幻想，随着赛车准备参加美国大奖赛。
尽管他在夏季期间表现出色，一直位居计时表前列，诺里斯最近承认，他那台木瓜机械的原始速度实际上掩盖了一个严重缺陷且不可预测的车架。
在奥斯汀的媒体活动中，诺里斯揭露了驾驶这辆车有多么苛刻。虽然他在赞德福特等赛道上看起来能够轻松甩开对手，但驾驶舱内的现实却是完全不同的故事。
“所以你知道我们并不是一路所向披靡，一切都很轻松；这辆车可能是我所驾驶过的最难开的赛车之一，”诺里斯解释道。“但我把事情串联起来，我开得很好，我能够应对，但这辆车并不是能让你赢得冠军的赛车。”
兰多·诺里斯，麦凯轮，奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂，麦凯轮，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
极端狭窄的操作窗口意味着周六要确保赛道位置需要近乎超人的努力，在Q3阶段几乎没有任何犯错的空间。
"我的意思是那只是一辆更快的车，但我认为如果我们明年只有一辆和现在一样快的车，我们是不会赢得冠军的，" 当届冠军说，并指出要完成一圈需要极薄的差距。"这是一辆要完成一圈资格赛几乎是不可能的，而且要像我们这样快几乎也是不可能的。我的意思是，我三次获得杆位，我不知道是两百分之一秒还是什么，或者甚至没有获得杆位。
尽管诺里斯对在当前2026赛季结束前再赢得一场胜利保持乐观，但他对位于沃金克的工程部门就下赛季的发展路径发出了严峻的警告。如果车手不能在极限状态下信任汽车，那么风洞中的原始下压力数据将毫无意义。
"所以我仍然相信今年还有可能赢得一场胜利；我们只需要一辆现在更快的车，如果我们想要赢得胜利的话，" 他陈述道。"但到了明年，我们需要一辆更容易驾驶、更可操控的汽车，因为以目前汽车难以驾驶的程度，你是不可能赢得冠军的。"
与一辆臭名昭著的难以驾驭且不可预测的赛车搏斗，对于诺里斯来说，这周末在美洲赛车场的绝对不是他需要的，这条赛道已经对整个车阵造成了物理上的打击。
多位车手对奥斯汀赛道严重的坑洼和不平的沥青路面进行了严厉的批评。诺里斯最近在接受记者采访时透露，强烈的垂直负荷迫使他不得不服用头痛药来应对对头枕的冲击。当你将本质上难以驾驭、边缘锋利的底盘与震耳欲聋的赛道相结合时，迈凯轮在德克萨斯州面临着极其严苛的物理和技术挑战。
detailEn: Norris issues brutal warning to McLaren: “One of the hardest cars I’ve ever had to drive”
Despite securing poles and commanding wins earlier this season, Lando Norris admits his McLaren was a total nightmare to handle on track
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

When a Formula 1 driver strings together a streak of pole positions and commanding race victories, the natural assumption is that their car is perfectly dialled in and driving like it's on rails. But Lando Norris is completely shattering that illusion for McLaren fans as the grid prepares for the United States Grand Prix.

Despite an incredibly strong run over the summer that saw him consistently topping the timing sheets, Norris recently confessed that the raw speed of his papaya machinery actually masked a deeply flawed and unpredictable chassis.

During his media availability in Austin, Norris pulled back the curtain on just how demanding the car has been behind the wheel. While he looked comfortable pulling away from the pack at tracks such as Zandvoort, the reality inside the cockpit was a completely different story.

"So you know it wasn't like we were just winning everything and it was easy; the car was probably one of the hardest cars I've ever had to drive," Norris explained. "But I was putting things together, and I was driving well, and I could get away with it, but this isn't a car that you can win a championship with."
Lando Norris, McLaren, Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
The extremely narrow operating window meant that securing track position required near-superhuman efforts on Saturdays, leaving absolutely no margin for error during Q3.

"I mean that's just a quicker car, but I think next year we're not going to win the championship if we just have a car that was as quick as it," the reigning champ said, noting the razor-thin margins required to put a lap together. "This was a car that to put a qualifying lap together was almost impossible, and to be as quick as we were was almost impossible. I mean, I was on pole three times by, I don't know what, two hundredths of a second or something, or not even on pole."

While Norris remains optimistic about stealing another victory before the current 2026 campaign concludes, he issued a stark warning to the engineering department back in Woking regarding their development path for next season. Raw downforce numbers in the wind tunnel will mean absolutely nothing if the drivers cannot trust the car at the limit.

"So I still believe a win is possible this year; we just need a car that is quicker now if we want to just have a win," he stated. "But into next year we need a car that's a lot more derivable, easier to drive, because you simply cannot win a championship with how difficult the car is to drive at the minute."

Wrestling a notoriously difficult and unpredictable car is the absolute last thing Norris needs this weekend at the Circuit of the Americas, a track that is already physically battering the entire grid.

Several drivers have heavily criticised the severe bumps and uneven asphalt in Austin. Norris recently revealed to reporters that the violent vertical loads have forced him to take headache tablets just to cope with the impacts against his headrest. When you combine an inherently tricky, knife-edge chassis with a bone-rattling circuit, McLaren is facing a highly punishing physical and technical challenge in Texas.

items.originalTitle: George Russell reveals he lost sleep over his own driving, not the F1 championship
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔透露他因自己的驾驶问题失眠，而非F1冠军争夺战。
梅赛德斯车手表示，他自己的表现不佳让他夜不能寐，而非与队友基米·安东内利的冠军争夺战。
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和赛事分析。
众所周知，2026赛季对乔治·拉塞尔来说是一场噩梦。当他的19岁队友安德烈亚·基米·安东内利正朝着可能的驾驶员冠军头衔稳步前进时，拉塞尔却受到了机械故障、运气不佳和赛车不适合其驾驶风格的残酷影响。
当事情变得如此糟糕时，大多数车手开始指责工程师或抱怨赛车。但正如停机区为美国大奖赛在德克萨斯州奥斯汀的举行做准备时，拉塞尔正采取一种完全不同的方法：深入自我反思。
在周四的媒体日在美国赛车场，拉塞尔对赛季给他带来的心理压力进行了非常坦率的讨论。
“这是一个非常独特的赛季。这是一个考验我的性格和韧性的赛季，你知道的，我不得不多次照镜子，思考我如何从这些打击中反弹，”拉塞尔向媒体解释道。
随着安东内利在奥斯汀或墨西哥城以数学上的位置有可能赢得世界冠军，拉塞尔被迫直面自己的挑战，而不是沉溺于失望之中。
“我只是想放弃并接受不幸或糟糕的表现，还是想尝试纠正它，充分利用它，控制我能控制的一切？”他补充道。
拉塞尔坦白的最大吸引力在于什么最让他困扰。你自然会认为看着一个青少年在完全相同的机器上完全统治发车线会是终极的自尊心杀手，但拉塞尔声称冠军积分榜并不是他焦虑的源头。
“当我说我们本赛季不再有竞争力时，我并没有什么强烈的感受，因为当我回顾年初的时候，让我夜不能寐的并不是冠军的事实；更多的是我的表现并没有达到我想要的水平，我想，我该如何将我的表现恢复到我知道我能够达到的水平？”拉塞尔承认。

而不是担心巨大的积分差距，这位英国车手在为体育技术的方面以及无法从W17中提取速度而失眠。
“我需要从这辆车中得到什么？我需要改变我的驾驶方式才能回到顶峰？然后显然还有不幸的事情，这就像在伤口上撒盐，”他陈述道。
确实有很多不幸的事情发生——包括他在在雪邦的最后几圈比赛中排名第三时发生的毁灭性的动力单元故障，这最终迫使他在新加坡的下一场比赛中遭受痛苦的发车处罚。
尽管2026赛季的现实令人沮丧，但拉塞尔显然正在利用这次残酷的经历来为未来的心理韧性打下基础。
“但你都知道，我打算在这里待很多很多年，你知道，当你被踢到地板上时，你不能放弃，你必须反弹回来，你必须更强地反弹回来，而且是的，我至少可以自豪地说，在那方面我已经全力以赴了，”他总结道。
detailEn: George Russell reveals he lost sleep over his own driving, not the F1 championship
The Mercedes driver says his own lack of performance kept him awake at night, not losing the championship fight to teammate Kimi Antonelli
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

It is no secret that the 2026 Formula 1 season has been an absolute nightmare for George Russell. While his 19-year-old team-mate Andrea Kimi Antonelli is currently cruising toward a potential Drivers' Championship title, Russell has been plagued by a brutal mix of mechanical failures, bad luck, and a car that simply doesn't suit his driving style.

When things get this bad, most drivers start pointing fingers at the engineers or complaining about the car. But as the paddock gears up for the United States Grand Prix in Austin, Texas, Russell is taking a completely different approach: intense self-reflection.
During Thursday's media day at the Circuit of the Americas, Russell got incredibly candid about the psychological toll the season has taken on him.

"It has been a very unique season. It has been a season where it's tested my character and resilience a lot, and you know, having to look at myself in the mirror numerous times and think how do I want to bounce back from these blows," Russell explained to the press.

With Antonelli mathematically positioned to potentially clinch the world title in Austin or Mexico City, Russell was forced to confront his own struggles head-on rather than drown in the disappointment.
"Do I just want to give up and accept the misfortune or the poor performances, or do I want to try and rectify it and make the most of it and control everything I can control?" he added.

The most fascinating part of Russell's admission is what actually bothered him the most. You would naturally assume that watching a teenager completely dominate the grid in the exact same machinery would be the ultimate ego-killer, but Russell claims the championship standings were not the source of his anxiety.

"I don't really have any major feelings running through my body when I say that we're no longer in the fight this season because I think when I look back earlier in the year, the things that were keeping me up at night wasn't necessarily the facts of the championship; it was more that my performance wasn't where I wanted it to be, and it was like, well, how am I going to get my performance back to the levels I know I'm capable of?" Russell admitted.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
Instead of stressing over the massive points deficit, the Brit was losing sleep over the technical side of the sport and his inability to extract pace from the W17.
"What is it I need from the car? What do I need to change in my driving to get back on top of things? And then obviously with the misfortune that just sort of added salt to the wound," he stated.

There has certainly been plenty of misfortune to go around—including a devastating power unit failure while he was running third in the closing laps at Sepang, which ultimately forced a painful grid penalty at the following race in Singapore.
Despite the crushing reality of the 2026 campaign, Russell is clearly using the brutal experience to build his mental toughness for the future.

"But you know I intend to be here for many, many, many years to come and you can't give up when you're, you know, being kicked to the floor and you gotta bounce back, you gotta bounce back even stronger, and yeah I can at least be proud that I've given it my all in that regard," he concluded.
